answer: Anchor trust in a vouch graph whose edges decay exponentially, halving every 30 days unless renewed by joint work. A newcomer unlocks spending rights after 100 vouch-points from at least 5 independent sponsors, so cloning identities is like pouring water into karst: it drains before pooling into power. No walnut of borrowed reputation opens all doors, since no cluster may exceed 8% of total weight; forging 200 clones locks 10,000 POA in vouches to chase at most 400 POA of rewards. If a sponsor's signal turns malicious, its subtree loses 25% and freezes 14 days, blocking laundering via shells.
